title: research: prove six calls for a three-source shear with one four-valued phase
body:
Three independent dirty-source transfers y_j += (C-I)x_j require exactly six C/C^-1 calls when C has all four character values 1,i,-1,-i. The lower bound permits arbitrary constant invertible complex role mixing and any number of restored arbitrary-dirty helpers. It excludes other phase functions and additional character-dependent gates, including free C^2/Pauli/address operations. This is a scoped written theorem with exact canonical checks; no new kappa or supplier admission.

The proof reduces a four-call candidate to phase-direction span three or four. Laurent interpolation excludes the four-dimensional case. The three-dimensional case forces two alternating target loops whose simultaneous constant-transfer images have ranks one and two. Six direct calls attain the required complete map. Eight binary-spectrum four-call words remain valid positive controls, showing why the full-spectrum premise matters.

Only research/four-spectrum-shear/ is added: README, proof, verifier/regenerator, exact certificate and attribution notice. Python 3.10+ standard library:

    python3 -I -B research/four-spectrum-shear/verify.py

Expected: PASS_FOUR_SPECTRUM_SHEAR minimum=6 binary_minimum=4 controls=7 no_new_kappa.

Validation: separate native and Python exact engines agree on all mathematical certificate fields; normal, isolated optimized, relocated and applied-patch replay pass; deterministic regeneration is byte-identical; seven mathematical mutations and two on-disk/output controls reject. The general case split is not proof-assistant formalized. No selected supplier/record, frozen package or framework is changed; full selected replay is outside this standalone change.

Prepared by Richard Hoekstra with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human peer review or literature-priority claim. Context and distinct model boundaries are credited for PR1235, PR836, PR800, PR720 and PR990. Open next questions cover the three-value spectrum and explicitly paid additional character-dependent gates.
